verdict: Leads pulled back sharply this week; Google spend is being redirected.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 130 leads at a cost of $19.85 per lead, all driven by Meta — Google Ads spent $1,239.78 in the same window and returned zero attributable leads. In the most recent 7 days, leads dropped 50% and cost per lead rose 29% week over week, with the sharpest falloff in the last three days pointing to creative fatigue on your primary Meta campaign. Google's budget is being pulled back while that situation is evaluated, and new ad creative — including a UGC batch — is on track to launch by end of August. Once fresh creative is live and money-path verification is complete, both lead volume and cost per lead should stabilise.
